method: Uses current load_membership, _load_prices and apply_price_repairs without mutating inputs or running a backtest.
Universe is exactly the 961 securities on the fixed 273 study rebalance dates; FCPT and MBGL appear only between those dates and are separately disclosed.
Membership snapshots are carried forward to XNYS sessions; price rows are never carried forward. Member-end date is the last included trading session, not the first exclusion date.
Valid price requires finite positive adjusted OHLC, high >= low, finite nonnegative volume; coverage here is not the nominal-field/60-session eligibility metric.
A series endpoint is a candidate data breakpoint, never proof of legal termination. Lists do not guess acquisition amounts.

terminal_candidate_summary.caution: Unregistered endpoints require event/source checks; the candidate counts are not proven mergers. CHK/PDCO/SNI fall in March 2018 and require extra provider-boundary scrutiny.

security_identity: Permanent security identifier (CUSIP/ISIN or vendor security ID), with validity dates
Legal issuer name and dated CIK when available
Exchange, share class, currency, actual ticker with start/end dates
Predecessor/successor links and legal continuity evidence; distinguish ticker reuse from a rename
nominal_market_data: XNYS session date; unadjusted open/high/low/close; unadjusted share volume
True last trading session, halt/suspension and delisting effective timestamps/dates
Coverage status for missing rows; no forward-fill and no invented post-termination prices
Source URL/vendor dataset ID, retrieval timestamp and raw file hash
distributions_and_adjustment: Cash dividends: amount, currency, ex-date, record date, pay date; flag ordinary versus special
Splits/reverse splits: effective date and share ratio; applicable fractional-share terms
Spin-offs/distributions: child security ID, ratio, ex-date/record/pay dates and cash-in-lieu terms
Reproducible adjustment factors and convention; nominal OHLCV retained separately
terminal_corporate_actions: Announcement date, public known date, completion date and first unavailable trading session
Mandatory/default per-old-share cash and stock consideration; successor permanent ID, ticker and exchange ratio
Election/proration rules when relevant; record holder rounding, fractional-share and cash-in-lieu method
Separate ordinary dividends from merger consideration; state whether archived returns already embed distributions
Actual broker cash timing only when observed; otherwise keep ADR014 effective+5 XNYS sessions visibly modeled
Successor nominal and adjusted price histories covering entitlement valuation and strategy exit
